title: Primary database server
summary: Host and version of the main Postgres
body: db-prim-02.internal, Postgres 16.2, port 5432. Connection pooling through pgbouncer on 6432.

title: Nightly backup job
body: Backups run at 03:15 UTC and the dump goes to the lf-backups bucket.

title: Daily sync meeting
summary: Time and place of the daily meeting
body: Daily at 10:15 on Zoom. Written notes still go to #eng-standup.

title: Plans and prices
body: Free, Pro 35 EUR per month, Business 120 EUR per month. Annual billing gives two months free.

title: Deploy windows
body: No production deploys on Thursday after 16:00 local time or on weekends. Hotfixes need approval from the engineering manager.

title: Session store
body: Sessions are stored in redis-sess-2.internal:6380, maxmemory 4gb, allkeys-lfu eviction. Nothing else should write to this instance.

title: Support response targets
body: Pro within 2 business hours, Free within 2 business days, Business within 1 hour around the clock. Breaches are reported weekly.

title: Design tokens package
summary: Repo and npm name of the design tokens
body: Tokens live at github.com/lumenfold/design-tokens and are published to npm as @lumenfold/design-tokens. Designers edit them in Figma and a bot opens the PR.

title: Grafana dashboards
body: Grafana is at metrics.lumenfold.io. The important dashboards are in the folder Core SLOs: latency, error rate, saturation.

title: Feature flags
body: Unleash is self-hosted at toggles.lumenfold.io. Each environment has its own SDK key; frontends use the proxy endpoint.

title: On-call roster
summary: Who is primary and secondary on call
body: Weekly handoff on Monday at 10:00 CET. Primary on-call is Tomas, secondary is Ines. Swaps are agreed in #oncall and noted in PagerDuty.

title: Transactional email sender
body: Transactional email is sent through Postmark. The from address is hello@lumenfold.io; marketing mail uses a different tool.

title: Sentry retired
body: We no longer use Sentry for error tracking. Errors are sent to Honeycomb and alerts still post to #alerts-eng.

title: Payments checkout provider
body: Stripe is out. Checkout now runs on Adyen and the webhook endpoint is /hooks/adyen. Refunds are issued from the Adyen portal.

title: Frontend tooling note
summary: Package manager and runtime for web
body: We stopped using pnpm; the monorepo runs on Bun 1.1 now. Vite 5 stays as the bundler and node 20 is only kept for CI.

title: Remote access
summary: How to reach internal services remotely
body: WireGuard is not used anymore. Access goes through Tailscale: ask IT for an invite and there is no config file to download.

title: Why do we get logged out after 5 minutes?
body: Q: why does the web app log me out so fast? A: the access token lifetime in Keycloak (auth.lumenfold.io, realm lumenfold) was cut from 15 to 5 minutes. Refresh tokens still last 8 hours.

title: 2024-06-12 prod cluster upgrade
summary: Log of the production cluster upgrade
body: Upgraded lf-prod to Kubernetes 1.30 today and scaled the node group from 12 to 16 m6i.large. Region is still eu-central-1.

title: Changelog: base images
summary: Changelog entry for the base images
body: [2024-07-02] python base is now 3.13-slim. node stays on 20-alpine. Still pinned by digest and rebuilt weekly.

title: Did sprint length change?
summary: Answer about the new sprint length
body: Yes. Sprints are three weeks now and start on Monday. Planning is Monday 10:00 and the retro is on the last Friday.

title: Meeting 2024-06-18 roadmap sync
body: Agreed in the roadmap sync: SSO moves to Q4 and usage-based billing is pulled forward. Self-serve onboarding stays first.

title: Retention rules
body: Application logs are kept 14 days, analytics events 13 months and database backups 35 days. Deletion jobs run nightly.

title: Nimbus billing API endpoints
summary: Billing API URL, auth and timeout
body: Base URL is https://billing.lumenfold.io/v3. Authentication uses a bearer token read from Vault path secret/billing. Default request timeout is 10 seconds.

title: Push notification worker
summary: Queue and retry settings for push
body: A Go service that sends push through FCM and APNs. Work is queued in the SQS queue notif-q-v2 and failed sends are retried 5 times.

title: Hardware and device management
body: New hires get a MacBook Pro 14. FileVault must be on and devices are enrolled in Jamf. Screen lock after 5 minutes. Lost devices are reported to IT within an hour.

title: Thumbnail service
body: Now a container on ECS Fargate that replaced the Lambda. Uses sharp, max input 50 MB, outputs avif and webp. Triggered by S3 uploads in the media bucket.

title: Where alerts go
body: Critical alerts page Opsgenie team lf-core. Warning alerts go to the Slack channel #alerts-warn only and never page anyone.

title: Where product events land
body: Product events are in Snowflake, account lf-xy123, database PROD_EVENTS. Access is granted through the analysts Okta group.

title: DR exercise
body: The exercise runs quarterly. The last one was in November and a full restore took 27 minutes.

title: Supportzeiten
body: Der Support ist Montag bis Freitag von 9 bis 18 Uhr erreichbar, samstags von 10 bis 14 Uhr nur per E-Mail.

title: Rechnungsnummern
body: Rechnungen werden als RE-2025-xxxxx nummeriert, die Mehrwertsteuer betraegt 19 Prozent und das Zahlungsziel ist 14 Tage.

title: Mise en production Lyon
body: Le serveur lyon-app-03 heberge l'application pour le bureau de Lyon. La mise en production a lieu le mardi a 18h.

title: Python lint config
body:
## Python lint

```toml
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
```

Type hints are required in new modules. Docstrings only where behaviour is not obvious.

title: Branch naming
body:
## Workflow

```bash
git switch -c feat/ABC-123-short-slug
git push -u origin HEAD
```

Trunk-based with short-lived branches. Pull requests are rebase merged into main.

title: Plans and prices v3
body: Free, Pro 39 EUR per month, Business 120 EUR per month, Enterprise on request.

body: Analytics reads go to db-repl-02.internal. Alert fires when replication lag exceeds 120s. Never run migrations against it.

title: Kubernetes cluster dev
body: EKS cluster lf-dev in eu-central-1 on Kubernetes 1.30 with 2 nodes. It is scaled to zero at night.

title: Admin console URL

title: Redis job queue

title: CI runner pool for macOS
body: Self-hosted GitHub Actions runners: 4 machines labelled lf-macos, hosted on MacStadium. iOS jobs must use the lf-macos label.

title: Sprint cadence for the design team
summary: Sprint rhythm of the design team
body: One-week sprints starting on Monday. Planning is Monday 09:30 and the review happens on Friday.

title: Staging on-call rotation
summary: Who is on call for staging
body: Weekly handoff on Monday at 10:00 CET. Primary on-call is Pia, secondary is Jonas. Swaps are agreed in #oncall-staging.

title: Support response targets for enterprise
body: Enterprise customers get a first response within 30 minutes and a dedicated Slack channel. Breaches are escalated to the account owner.

title: Staging database host
body: The staging database is db-stg-01.internal running Postgres 16.2 on port 5432. Data is refreshed from an anonymised dump each Sunday.

title: Dev environment URL
summary: Address of the dev web app
body: The dev environment is at https://dev.lumenfold.io behind basic auth. Credentials are in the 1Password vault Eng.

title: Search load test
summary: Load test of the search cluster
body: Marrow search sustained 800 qps with a p95 of 90 ms in the May run, using the three existing nodes.

title: Postgres connection usage
body: Peak connections reached 340 of the 500 maximum on Tuesdays during the billing run. Consider raising the pool size if it passes 400.

title: Payment processing fees
body: Card transactions cost 0.60 EUR plus 1.3 percent. Monthly volume is roughly 41k EUR and about 1100 transactions.

title: Backup size
body: The nightly dump is about 480 GB compressed. A restore needs 2 TB of scratch space and roughly 40 minutes of copy time.

title: Session cache memory usage
body: The session cache hovers around 1.2 GB of its limit with an eviction rate near zero. Peak was 1.7 GB during the April campaign.

title: Onboarding survey results
body: New hires rated onboarding 4.3 out of 5. The main complaint is that access requests take about 2 days.

title: Mobile CI pipeline
body: Orchard builds on Bitrise and takes about 12 minutes on average. Signing certificates come from the shared match repository.

title: Billing SLO alert
body: The billing SLO alert fires when 5xx responses exceed 1 percent for 5 minutes. It pages the secondary after 15 minutes.

title: Keycloak admin access
body: The Keycloak admin console is reachable only over the VPN. Realm changes need two-person approval.

title: Python SDK release process
summary: How the Python SDK is released
body: Tag vX.Y.Z on main and a GitHub Action publishes to PyPI. The changelog is CHANGELOG.md.

title: Marrow has no Kibana
summary: Tooling note for the search cluster
body: The Marrow cluster has no Kibana. Use curl against the API or the opensearch-cli aliases from the dotfiles repo.

title: Orchard does not use Expo
summary: Stack note for the mobile app
body: Orchard is bare React Native, not Expo. Native modules live in ios/ and android/.

title: Staging has no real payments
body: Staging runs the payment provider in sandbox mode, so no real charges are possible.

summary: Incident log for the search cluster
body: Marrow lost two nodes for 40 minutes after a disk-full event. Fixed by adding a 200 GB volume per node.

body: Retro: deploys felt slow. Action: investigate runner queue time. Owner is Ines.

title: Release notes automation
body: Release Please opens a release PR on main after each merge. Notes come from conventional commit messages.

title: Lunch spots near the Berlin office
summary: Places to eat near Rosenthaler Str.
body: Cocolo Ramen and Zeit fuer Brot are both a two minute walk from Rosenthaler Str. 40.

title: Bike parking
body: There is no car parking at the office. Bike racks are in the courtyard on the 3rd floor side.
